message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a tool available to fetch or recommend documentaries. However, I can suggest some well‑known titles that you might look up:

| Documentary | Year | Synopsis |
|-------------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice President Al Gore’s presentation on climate change and its global impact. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | Follow‑up to the original, covering progress and setbacks in climate policy. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio explores the causes and consequences of climate change worldwide. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC documentary that examines the science behind global warming and its effects. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from around the world. |

You can find these on major streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, Disney+, etc.) or on YouTube/Google Play. If you’d like more details about any particular film or help locating it on a specific platform, just let me know!
